_meta.systematic_finding: `commentator_attribution_ok=false` is NOT sufficient to overturn a judge `keep`. The segmenter files a ṭīkā chunk under an adjacent verse whenever a merged-range marker (।। 5.27.30,31 ।।) shifts it, so the commentator IS attested — one bundle over. The judge, reading whole sargas, saw this; the per-verse check cannot. Eight cards (5.25.6, 5.27.30, 5.44.17, 5.52.19, 5.53.5, 5.67.30, 5.68.23, 5.33.11) carry that false positive and are accepted on the judge's verbatim quotation.
